svg.text: MESA Problem 9-2. Live news is read every day, scored in plain code and emailed to Ananya on Monday morning, so she
knows which companies are worth a call this week. Gemini Flash reads and drafts; it never decides.
The AI never picks the winners. Gemini turns articles
into facts it can point to; plain code applies the gates
and the score, so every tier traces back to the article.
A name that is not in the text is dropped, not guessed.
Ananya sends every email herself, from her own Gmail
She decides who to call; the system ranks and drafts
A meeting is booked only after the lead says yes
One feed fails → the other eight still run
No article text → kept, marked headline only
Gemini limit hit → the next Flash model takes over
74 automated tests cover scoring, gates and actions
CSR Partnership Radar · live news → plain-code score → Monday digest
